USD.note: SAME-DAY SOURCE, AND IT MATCHES OUR OWN CAPTURE. 'The US dollar is broadly stronger today' on a hot September CPI - 3.7% against 3.6% expected, with core YoY 2.6% vs 2.5% and core MoM 0.3% vs 0.2%. Our capture carries the identical prints, so this is verified twice rather than taken on trust. USD/CAD peaked at 1.4299, its highest since April 2025. The author frames it as rate-path convergence: markets price 97bp of BoC hikes against 92bp for the Fed over the next year.
